consigne: Une seule réponse correcte par question. Mélange grammaire, vocabulaire et civilisation.

questions.enonce: I finally got him ___ the truth.
questions.explication: « Get someone to do » : get + COD + to + base verbale.

questions.enonce: She was tired because she ___ all night.
questions.explication: Past perfect continuous : action prolongée antérieure, cause d'un état passé.
Le contraire de « to allow » est « to forbid » (interdire).

questions.enonce: What are the first ten amendments to the US Constitution called?
questions.explication: Les dix premiers amendements forment le Bill of Rights.

questions.enonce: If they had left earlier, they ___ the plane.
questions.explication: Type 3 (irréel du passé) : if + past perfect, would have + participe.

questions.enonce: He said he would come the ___ day.
questions.explication: Discours indirect : « next day » devient « the following day ».

questions.enonce: Choose the correct collocation: to ___ a goal.
questions.explication: On dit « to achieve a goal » (atteindre un objectif).

choix: The UK leaving the European Union
questions.explication: « Brexit » = sortie du Royaume-Uni de l'Union européenne.
Proposition participiale antériorité : « Having + participe passé ».

questions.enonce: She ___ be at work; it's Sunday.
questions.explication: Déduction d'improbabilité : « can't » (elle ne peut pas être).

questions.enonce: The plane ___ on time despite the fog.
Which US holiday is celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November?
questions.explication: Thanksgiving se fête le 4e jeudi de novembre aux États-Unis.
